layman_headline: Both open trades are up ~4% — let them ride toward their targets, no new buys today.
layman_explanation: Our two current positions, Solana and Uniswap, are both showing healthy gains of about 4% each. Solana has rallied 12% in a week and is approaching our $115 profit target. UNI surged 16% in 24 hours and 21% in a week — getting close to our $5.65 exit. The new candidates on the watchlist are either overbought (PUMP at RSI 84), lack technical data (MON, XPL), or are stablecoins. There's no compelling new setup worth risking capital on right now.
layman_action: Hold both existing positions. Consider tightening your SOL stop-loss to around $98 to lock in some gains. Watch for UNI to hit the $5.65 target for a profitable exit. Don't chase anything new today.
expert_reasoning: Both open positions are performing well within their defined risk/reward envelopes. SOL at $105.10 is 4% above entry with a 12.2% 7-day gain and $2B daily volume — strong but potentially extended; the $115 target is ~9.4% away. UNI at $5.10 is 4.3% above entry with explosive 16.2% daily and 20.7% weekly moves — the $5.65 target is only ~10.8% away and could be hit within days. Among new candidates, PUMP's RSI of 84 screams overbought and is a clear avoid. MON and XPL show 8-10% pullbacks but lack RSI, MACD, and SMA data to confirm a setup. High BTC dominance at 59.5% continues to pressure alts, making new alt entries risky. The CryptoSlate note about $739B in new US debt potentially absorbing crypto liquidity is a macro headwind worth monitoring.
